features: Promise fs.watch now returns a genuine lazy async generator with next/return/throw and self async-iterator identity. Native watcher creation occurs at iteration admission. File URL paths use actual fileURLToPath conversion and Buffer paths retain native byte identity.

Abort-before-start creates no watcher. Active abort closes the native watcher, preserves AbortError cause and retires the signal listener. Iteration exit, native close/error and generator cleanup share a finally block that closes native state and clears queued events.

Options validate persistent/recursive/signal/encoding/maxQueue/overflow. The queue is bounded with the real Node overflow code/message or warning behavior. Ignore matching and ordinary UTF8 native events pass unchanged upstream controls.
limitations: Queue flooding/stress, every overflow/error combination, abort stopPropagation resistance, exact native watcher hook identity and Linux/Windows/Release/ASAN remain unverified or incomplete. No stress fixtures were run or credited.

The current Node promise watcher rejects buffer encoding; initial reference failure remains retained. Node also delivered a directory startup event before the file event; the rejected first-event assumption is retained. The refined UTF8 control waits for the named event under a fixed timeout and passes on Node and Home. Existing Bun buffer/string-option extensions are preserved but are not a Node parity claim.

Two upstream TODOs receive no pass credit. General native producers/Promise hooks, FileHandle transfer, performance/corpus/context/HTTPS work and full Bun-suite remain #66/#877 and related open issues.
Explicit Pickier scans match baseline eighteen errors and reduce warnings from 111 to 109, zero new findings.
